name: Enapps ERP B2B Integration for WooCommerce
author: enapps-erp

sections.description:
The Enapps ERP B2B Integration for WooCommerce Plugin bridges the gap between WooCommerce and Enapps ERP, enabling seamless two-way integration for real-time data synchronisation and enhanced B2B capabilities.
▶️ View Live Demo

Third Party Service

This plugin connects to the external Enapps ERP service for the purpose of synchronising products, orders and customer account information. All integration requests are sent to https://enapps.com via its ERP API.

Use of the plugin therefore involves transmitting data to this third‑party service. Please review the following links for more information:
* Enapps Terms and Conditions
* Enapps Security Statement
* Enapps Privacy Policy

Detailed installation instructions are available in the Enapps Academy guide.
For a full overview of plugin usage, see Enapps Ecommerce plugin documentation.

Features

Lite Plugin (Free)

  • Real-Time Pricing and Stock Updates
    Show customers their specific pricing and live stock availability directly from Enapps ERP.
  • Seamless Product and User Synchronisation
    Synchronise products and users from Enapps ERP to WooCommerce.
  • Enhanced Account Area
    Replaces WooCommerce’s default account screens with real-time ERP data for orders, shipments, and invoices.
  • Automated Order Management
    Orders and payments made online are instantly pushed to Enapps ERP, eliminating manual intervention.

Enterprise Version (Premium)

Unlock advanced functionality and tailored solutions:
– Backorder Management
Handle backorders seamlessly with real-time ERP updates.
– Dynamic Shipping Calculations
Calculate shipping costs dynamically using ERP data.
– Bespoke Checkout Rules
Define rules based on account standing, credit limits, and more.
– Custom Payment Options
Offer payment-on-account or card payments, based on ERP-driven rules.
– Fully Managed Service
Includes front-end customisation, staging environments, and implementation support.

For Enterprise version inquiries, contact enquiries@enapps.co.uk.

Usage

  • Products must be synced from Enapps ERP to WordPress.
  • Verify that products display correctly on the site.
  • Verify that orders are correctly transferred to Enapps ERP.

Support

For support inquiries, contact enquiries@enapps.co.uk.

Upgrade to Enterprise

Take your B2B ecommerce to the next level with the Enterprise Version, offering advanced features and a fully managed service.

Contact us at enquiries@enapps.co.uk to learn more or request a demo.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and Activate the Plugin

    • Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
    • Upload the Plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
    • Activate the Plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

  2. Configure the Plugin

    • Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Integration >Enapps ERP B2B Integration for WooCommerce.
    • Enter the following details (provided by Enapps Support):
      • Server URL
      • Shop ID
      • API Token
    • Click Save Changes.

  3. Update Permalinks

    • Navigate to Settings > Permalinks.
    • Click Save Changes (without modifying any settings) to refresh the link structure.

  4. Check Membership Settings

    • Navigate to Settings > General.
    • Ensure that “Anyone can register” is disabled.
    • If enabled, uncheck it and click Save Changes.

  5. Get Started

    • Push products and user accounts from Enapps ERP to WooCommerce to get started.
sections.faq:
What do I need to use this Plugin?

You must be an Enapps ERP user with API access enabled.

What happens if the ERP does not return a product price?

The standard product price will be used instead.

Can I modify the Plugin for my custom needs?

Yes, the Lite Plugin supports theme customisation. The Enterprise version includes full front-end customisation as a managed service. Please note: custom modifications should first be tested in a development environment before applying to the live site.

Can I use multiple Shipping Addresses?

Yes, you can enable multiple shipping addresses by installing an additional plugin, such as Multiple Shipping Addresses for WooCommerce (Address Book). This allows customers to manage and select from several saved shipping addresses during checkout.

Does this Plugin work with non-standard WooCommerce solutions?

If using custom solutions that display product lists outside WooCommerce pages, avoid displaying prices and stock levels. Contact Enapps Support for assistance.

Does the Plugin support multicurrency?

Not yet, but multicurrency support is on our roadmap.

What kind of support is available?

  • Lite Plugin Users: Email support only.
  • Enterprise Clients: Enjoy managed implementation and dedicated support.
